title: Apple Continuity and cross-device system user caches residual
scope: Apple Continuity and related system USER caches under $HOME only, not already primary targets in macos-apple-extended: Handoff/useractivityd, Universal Clipboard (shared-pasteboard), AirPlay receiver residual, Sidecar/Screen Continuity, Continuity Camera residual, Continuity Markup, Apple Watch AutoUnlock residual, iCloud Photos agent caches (not library), iCloud Drive bird/CloudDocs residual report-only carefully, CloudKit residual user agent leaves, Push/UserNotifications residual, APSD/AOSPush residual, CallHistory residual careful medium/report-only, FaceTime residual, Messages regenerable cache leaves report-only (Messages is never-touch for chat.db/Attachments), Siri suggestions residual, Proactive residual, DuetExpertCenter residual streams/metrics, KnowledgeC report-only, Biome residual (databases/streams/sync beyond tmp/compute), IntelligencePlatform residual Artifacts. Prefer medium/report-only for privacy-adjacent stores.
safety_notes: NEVER touch Keychains, Mail full data, Messages chat.db or Attachments content, Photos Library.photoslibrary, Mobile Documents, CloudStorage, File Provider Storage under iCloud Drive groups, Documents/Desktop/Downloads.

Messages is never-touch for conversation data. Only explicit regenerable cache leaves (Caches, StickerCache, CollaborationNoticeCache, NickNameCache) and only as report-only unless product policy later promotes carefully.
CallHistoryDB/CallHistoryTransactions hold call history: report-only. callservicesd group Library/Caches only is medium residual.
FaceTime Application Support FaceTime.sqlite* is call-related DB: never wipe. Only container/group Caches/tmp residual.
Universal Clipboard shared-pasteboard can hold large staged paste payloads (known multi-GB bloat). Cleaning drops pending cross-device paste; medium risk, default off.
Sharing/AutoUnlock holds Watch unlock pairing material (ltk, pairing-records): report-only only. Do not auto-delete pairing files.
bird Caches under ~/Library/Caches is already in apple-extended; this batch adds group-container and CloudKit bird residual carefully. Never wipe iCloud Drive file content or Mobile Documents.
CloudKit under ~/Library/Caches/CloudKit: narrow residual agent leaves only; never bulk-wipe all CloudKit as default. Safari CloudKit leaves belong to browser packs.
Biome: tmp and compute already cleanable in apple-extended. databases/streams/sync/sets are personalization residual: report-only.
IntelligencePlatform and KnowledgeC are privacy-adjacent ML stores: report-only.
IdentityServices crypto DBs and StatusKit full trees are sensitive; not bulk targets here (partially covered elsewhere).
path_count counts distinct path templates across rules (including report-only).
overlap_exclusions: macos-apple-extended: Biome/tmp, Biome/compute; bird/iCloud agent Caches; DuetExpertCenter + duetexpertd + proactive.eventtracker; IntelligencePlatform/Suggestions/PersonalizationPortrait report-only; Sharing/StatusKit/FrontBoard; Siri assistantd/parsecd/sirittsd; group.com.apple.siri.sirisuggestions and siri.userfeedbacklearning as group-container-apple-caches; VideoConference cache; com.apple.internal.ck
macos-batch-04 creative: Photos/cloudphotod app caches primary
macos-batch-10: CallHistoryDB report-only, Knowledge/DifferentialPrivacy/Duet medium, Biome report-only inventory
macos-batch-26: FaceTime container caches + Continuity Camera onboarding caches primary (this batch adds group residual and extras)
sources: Live host: Sharing/AutoUnlock pairing-records.plist and ltk.plist present (report-only)
Live host: group.com.apple.ScreenContinuityServices, Containers/com.apple.ScreenContinuity, AirPlayUIAgent, ContinuityCaptureOnboardingUI

Live host: Group Containers group.com.apple.sharingd, rapportd, replicatord, UserNotifications, FaceTime, telephonyutilities.callservicesd, bird, CloudDocs, iCloudDrive, photolibraryd.private, moments, siri.sirisuggestions, siri.remembers, siri.userfeedbacklearning
Live host: Application Support CallHistoryDB, CallHistoryTransactions, FaceTime sqlite, Knowledge/knowledgeC.db
Live host: Library/Biome/{tmp,compute,databases,streams,sync,sets}; IntelligencePlatform Artifacts + graph dbs
Live host: Caches/CloudKit agents bird, cloudphotod, facetimemessagestored, imagent, callhistory.sync-helper, knowledge-agent, biomesyncd, suggestd
Community: shared-pasteboard archives multi-GB bloat (useractivityd Universal Clipboard / Handoff paste staging)
Apple Continuity umbrella: Handoff, Universal Clipboard, Sidecar, Continuity Camera, AirPlay, Watch unlock, SMS relay

Not in macos-apple-extended primary paths: shared-pasteboard, ScreenContinuity*, useractivityd group leaves, Markup Continuity residual, Messages regenerable cache leaves, KnowledgeC path specificity, Biome databases/streams residual

rules.name: Universal Clipboard shared-pasteboard staging
rules.description: Handoff/Universal Clipboard staged pasteboard archives and items under useractivityd group. Known large reclaim surface.
rules.notes: Verified on host (~200MB+ typical; can reach multi-GB). Deleting drops pending cross-device paste payloads only; not user documents. Close apps mid-paste first. Prefer aged contents.

rules.name: Handoff useractivityd group caches
rules.description: Regenerable Caches/Application Support under useractivityd group (Handoff activity metadata), not the shared-pasteboard tree.
rules.notes: Handoff activity UI caches rebuild. Do not use this rule for shared-pasteboard (dedicated rule).

rules.name: CoreSpotlight PasteboardHistory residual
rules.description: Spotlight PasteboardHistory metadata residual related to clipboard indexing.
rules.notes: Clipboard-related Spotlight residual. Not full CoreSpotlight wipe (that is separate medium category in apple-extended).

rules.name: AirPlay receiver UI and diagnostic residual
rules.description: AirPlayUIAgent and AirPlay diagnostic extension container Caches/tmp only.
rules.notes: Receiver UI caches only. Does not change AirPlay settings plists. System AirPlay helpers outside $HOME are out of scope.

rules.name: Sidecar and Screen Continuity caches
rules.description: Screen Continuity / Sidecar / iPhone Mirroring related container and group caches.
rules.notes: May briefly disrupt active Sidecar/iPhone Mirroring session. Regenerable display/session caches; not user documents.

rules.name: Continuity Camera residual extras
rules.description: Continuity Camera residual beyond streaming batch primary: onboarding container already listed in batch 26; adds CMIO-related user cache leaves if present.
rules.notes: Overlap with batch-26 stream-continuity-camera intentional residual depth. Never system CoreMediaIO plugins.

rules.name: Continuity Markup residual caches
rules.description: MarkupUI Continuity Markup / markup photo extension regenerable caches and tmp.
rules.notes: Continuity Markup UI caches. Does not delete marked-up documents.

rules.name: Apple Watch AutoUnlock residual (report-only)
rules.description: Sharing/AutoUnlock holds Watch unlock pairing material. Report size only; never auto-delete pairing records.
rules.notes: Host verified pairing-records.plist and ltk.plist. Deleting breaks Watch unlock until re-pair. apple-extended may list Sharing broadly; this rule documents AutoUnlock as never auto-clean pairing.

rules.name: sharingd and rapportd Continuity residual caches
rules.description: Nearby Continuity transport residual under sharingd and rapportd group Library/Caches only.
rules.notes: Avoid AirDrop IDMS DB and rapport identity plist as wipe targets. ~/Library/Sharing bulk remains separate careful surface.

rules.name: iCloud Photos agent caches (not library)
rules.description: photolibraryd, mstreamd, moments, CloudPhotosConfiguration agent caches only. Never Photos Library.photoslibrary or File Provider Storage originals.
rules.notes: Batch-04 covers com.apple.Photos and cloudphotod top-level Caches; this adds agent/container residual. Never library originals.

rules.name: iCloud Drive bird/CloudDocs residual (report-only careful)
rules.description: bird/CloudDocs/iCloudDrive group Library/Caches and CloudDocs Application Support telemetry residual. Report-only; never File Provider Storage or Mobile Documents.
rules.notes: Primary ~/Library/Caches/com.apple.bird already in apple-extended as cleanable. Group containers and CloudDocs session/telemetry are careful report-only here. Never Mobile Documents or File Provider Storage.

rules.name: CloudKit residual user agent leaves (report-only)
rules.description: Selected CloudKit agent cache leaves for Continuity/iMessage/FaceTime/knowledge residual. Report sizes; do not bulk-wipe entire CloudKit root.
rules.notes: Privacy and sync residual. Prefer report and Storage recommendations over bulk delete. Safari CloudKit leaves stay in browser packs.

rules.name: Push and UserNotifications residual caches
rules.description: UserNotifications group caches, Notification Center UI residual, AOSPushRelay HTTPStorages.
rules.notes: APS/push daemon state is largely system-scoped; user leaves are residual. May clear notification presentation caches; not credentials.

rules.name: CallHistory DB residual (report-only careful)
rules.description: Call history store and transactions. Privacy-sensitive; report-only. Also lists CloudKit callhistory sync residual.
rules.notes: Overlap with batch-10 report rule intentional Continuity-domain documentation. Never auto-delete call history.

rules.name: callservicesd residual caches (medium careful)
rules.description: telephonyutilities callservicesd and callintelligenced regenerable caches only, not CallHistoryDB.
rules.notes: Does not delete CallHistory.storedata. May reset short-lived call UI state.

rules.name: FaceTime residual caches (not sqlite history)
rules.description: FaceTime group/container residual beyond streaming batch: group Caches, notification extension, facetimemessagestored CloudKit leave (cleanable container tmp only).
rules.notes: Never Application Support/FaceTime/*.sqlite*. VideoConference covered in apple-extended/batch-26.

rules.name: Messages regenerable caches (report-only)
rules.description: Explicit regenerable Messages cache leaves only. Messages content (chat.db, Attachments) is never-touch.
rules.notes: NEVER chat.db or Attachments. Report sizes of regenerable caches only; product may later promote StickerCache/Caches with extreme care and default off.

rules.name: Siri suggestions residual caches
rules.description: Siri suggestions group Library/Caches residual and related suggestion container leaves. Full Suggestions tree remains report-only in apple-extended.
rules.notes: Suggestions quality resets until relearn. Do not wipe full ~/Library/Suggestions SQLite stores via this rule (report-only elsewhere).

rules.name: Siri Remembers and inference residual (report-only)
rules.description: Privacy-adjacent Siri Remembers and inference stores. Report-only.
rules.notes: Contains personal inference DBs. Not auto-clean targets.

rules.name: Proactive and Duet residual streams/metrics
rules.description: DuetExpertCenter residual subtrees (streams, metrics, feedback, caches) and proactive reporting residual. Parent DuetExpertCenter already cleanable in apple-extended; this documents residual depth and medium privacy stance.
rules.notes: Resets app prediction / notification suggestion learning. Prefer default off. Full DuetExpertCenter root remains in apple-extended.

rules.name: KnowledgeC store (report-only)
rules.description: CoreDuet knowledgeC.db under Application Support/Knowledge. Privacy-sensitive activity knowledge graph.
rules.notes: Host verified knowledgeC.db. Deleting resets device activity knowledge used by suggestions; report-only preferred over batch-10 medium clean for Continuity safety posture.

rules.name: Biome residual databases/streams/sync (report-only)
rules.description: Biome personalization residual beyond tmp/compute already cleanable in apple-extended.
rules.notes: tmp and compute remain the only default-safe Biome leaves (apple-extended). streams/databases/sync hold personalization; report only.

rules.name: IntelligencePlatform residual Artifacts (report-only)
rules.description: IntelligencePlatform Artifacts and on-device knowledge residual. Full tree is report-only in apple-extended; documents residual Artifacts explicitly for Continuity/AI overlap.
rules.notes: Do not auto-delete graph.db / globalKnowledge.db roots. Report sizes for System Data investigations.

rules.name: TMPDIR Continuity clipboard and Handoff temps
rules.description: User temp Continuity/Handoff/clipboard staging under $TMPDIR only (never whole /private/var/folders).
rules.notes: Complements batch-07 AirDrop/continuity tmp rule with Continuity-specific globs. Never delete entire TMPDIR root node.
